newsitem.title: ITALY: Four injured in Italian train derailment.
newsitem.headline: Four injured in Italian train derailment.

text.p: Four people suffered minor injuries on Saturday when a passenger train travelling from southern Italy to the north derailed in Rome, state railway Ferrovie dello Stato said in a statement.
The train, bound for the northeast city of Turin from the southern city of Reggio Calabria, derailed outside Rome's Casalina Station early on Saturday, the statement said.
Three of the injured were discharged from hospital after treatment for minor injuries, while the fourth was expected to remain in hospital for 10 days.
The cause of the derailment was not immediately known.
Eight people were killed last January when a Milan-Rome train derailed in the northern city of Piacenza. Investigators suspected excess speed may have caused that accident.
